unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM malignancy risk stratification and management recommendations under region-specific guidelines (C-TIRADS) versus ACR-TIRADS
Clinician Likert-scale rating of LLM outputs for guideline adherence, patient safety, operational feasibility and clinical applicability

screen.reason: The study evaluated the performance and clinician trust of three LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-o3-mini, DeepSeek-R1) in thyroid nodule risk stratification using narrative ultrasound descriptors under different clinical guidelines (ACR-TIRADS vs C-TIRADS). It does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
